To understand the foundation of breath hold, you need to explore several key concepts:

Breathing Physiology: Familiarize yourself with how the respiratory system works, including the role of the diaphragm, lungs, and oxygen-carbon dioxide exchange.
Breath Hold Techniques: Learn about different methods for holding your breath, such as static apnea (holding your breath while stationary) and dynamic apnea (holding your breath while moving, like in freediving).
Relaxation: Understand that relaxation and reducing stress are crucial for extended breath holds. The more relaxed you are, the longer you can hold your breath.
Training: Practice specific exercises to increase lung capacity and efficiency, like deep diaphragmatic breathing and CO2 tolerance training.
Safety: Always practice breath holding in a safe environment, ideally with a buddy or under professional guidance, especially if you’re attempting prolonged breath holds.
By mastering these fundamentals, you can improve your breath-holding capacity and ensure you do so safely.

1. WATER DENSITY 
Seawater is denser than fresh water and pure water because dissolved salts increase its mass more than its volume. 🧠
2. BODY COMPOSITION 
Fat has a specific gravity of less than 1.0 and floats in water. A persons with a high proportion of fat will float while some individuals with very low fat levels, heavy bones, and high muscle mass will sink.
3.EQUIPMENT 
Particular materials of your wetsuit, mask and snorkel, such as plastic or clothes that can have air pockets.
4. AIR IN YOUR LUNGS
Full air in your lungs increases your floating as its act as a balloon or floater.
But as you go deeper this balloon compresses (shrink) due to pressure. 
5. DEPTH
You will float from 1 to 10 meters as the air in  your lungs makes you float. 
As you go deep, from 10 to 20 meters the air in your lungs compressed more which will help you become neutral. (You don’t sink you don’t float)
As you go deeper to 20 to 30 meters, that’s when our lungs is completely compressed which make your body weight heavier to free fall.
Cheat Code:
1 to 10 meters- you float
10 to 20 meters- you stay neutral 
20 to 30 meters or more - you sink

You want to fix your buoyancy?
1. Dive in a fresh water hehehe or pool lang
2. Get leaner 💪 
3. Wear weights and master your duckdive or form
4. Practice the suitable breath hold for your body.
5. 🤔Become a depth master hehe
6. PRACTICE PRACTICE 😉
